T: One very long day in New York. Snacks for the road.
D: John McClane and a Harlem shopkeeper race around the city solving a bomber's riddles.
P: Pour drinks when McClane gets the water jug puzzle.
S: turmeric pastry turnovers of curried beef mince, grabbed between Simon's riddles
Pastry turnovers filled with curried beef mince, turmeric pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
Crisp bacon, a fried egg with a broken yolk and American cheese melted on top, in a buttered toasted kaiser roll, salt, pepper and ketchup.
M: Buttermilk-soaked chicken thigh pieces dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 175C until crisp, served on hot waffles with butter and honey spiked with hot sauce.
roast lamb with oregano and lemon, shaved and crisped, over rice with tzatziki, tomato and pita
Lamb shoulder roasted with oregano and lemon, shaved thin and crisped in a pan, on rice with tzatziki, tomato, onion and warm pita.
W: chewy brown sugar caramel set with roasted peanuts, topped with milk chocolate and flaky salt

Chewy brown sugar caramel packed with roasted salted peanuts, set in a slab and topped with milk chocolate and flaky salt. Line a 20cm square tin. Heat 200g brown sugar, 100g butter, 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring, then boil 6 to 8 minutes to 118C. Stir in 200g roasted salted peanuts and pour into the tin. Cool 30 minutes, spread with 150g melted milk chocolate and sprinkle with flaky salt. Chill 2 hours and cut into squares.
butter cake under a thick cinnamon crumble, icing sugar, for the counter at the electrical shop
Butter cake topped with a thick cinnamon crumble, baked at 180C for 40 minutes, icing sugar.
K: lemon juice and sugar syrup topped up cold, 5 and 3 litre jugs to make 4
Fresh lemonade (lemon juice, sugar syrup, cold water) in a big jug, with a 5 and a 3 litre jug to work out exactly 4 litres.

flavour.sign: 138th Street at Amsterdam. Summer, 1995. Takeaway all day.

note.text: Chicken and waffles, a jug of water and a jug of lemonade. Somebody work out how to pour four exactly.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and fold up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; bake on the night

steps.text: Soften the onion in the oil, then brown the mince with the curry powder, thyme and salt.
Add the stock and simmer until almost dry, then stir in the breadcrumbs and cool.
Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the pastry sheets with turmeric mixed into the beaten egg and cut two 12cm rounds from each.
Spoon the filling onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush the tops with the rest of the egg.
Bake on lined trays until golden and flaky, about 25 minutes. Serve hot with hot sauce.

dishes.n: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll

steps.text: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of cheese on each to melt.
Split, butter and toast the rolls. Fill with bacon and egg, season and add tomato sauce.

veg.n: Smoky mushroom, egg and cheese on a roll

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil over high heat until browned and crisp at the edges, then stir through the smoked paprika.
Fry the eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of cheese on each to melt.
Split, butter and toast the rolls. Fill with the mushrooms and egg, season with salt and pepper and add tomato sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Chicken soaks up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Soak the chicken in the buttermilk and salt.
Soak in the fridge.
Dredge in the flour mixed with paprika and make the waffle batter.
Fry the chicken in oil at 175C in batches until at least 74C inside.
Cook the waffles in a waffle iron. Warm the honey with the hot sauce and drizzle over the chicken on the waffles.

veg.n: Harlem fried oyster mushrooms and waffles
veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms soak up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Soak the mushroom clusters in the buttermilk and salt for 30 minutes.
Dredge in the flour mixed with paprika and make the waffle batter.
Fry the mushrooms in oil at 175C in batches for about 4 minutes, until deep golden and crisp, then drain.
Cook the waffles in a waffle iron. Warm the honey with the hot sauce and drizzle over the mushrooms on the waffles.
Line a 20cm square tin. Heat the sugar, butter, cream and golden syrup, stirring, then boil to 118C.
Stir in the peanuts and pour into the tin.
Cool.
Spread with melted chocolate and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Chill, then cut into squares.
Rub the plain flour, brown sugar, cinnamon and cold butter into big crumbs.
Beat more butter with the caster sugar, add the eggs and fold in the self-raising flour and milk.
Spread in a lined 20cm tin and cover with the crumble.
Bake at 180C. Dust with icing sugar.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.
Juice about 10 lemons.
Chill the syrup, add the lemon juice and top up with cold water to exactly 4 litres. Serve over ice.

s.note: turmeric pastry turnovers of curried beef mince, grabbed between Simon's riddles
s.how: Soften the onion in the oil, then brown the mince with the curry powder, thyme and salt. Add the stock and simmer until almost dry, then stir in the breadcrumbs and cool. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush the pastry sheets with turmeric mixed into the beaten egg and cut two 12cm rounds from each. Spoon the filling onto half of each round, fold over and crimp with a fork. Brush the tops with the rest of the egg. Bake on lined trays until golden and flaky, about 25 minutes. Serve hot with hot sauce.

s.n: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll
s.how: Fry 8 rashers bacon until crisp. Fry 4 eggs in the same pan, breaking the yolks, and lay a slice of American cheese on each to melt. Split and butter 4 kaiser rolls and toast them. Fill with 2 rashers bacon and an egg each, season with salt and pepper and add tomato sauce.

m.how: Soak 600g boneless chicken thighs in 300ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Dredge in 200g flour with 1 tsp paprika and fry at 175C for 7 minutes until 74C inside. Cook 8 small waffles from a 300g mix. Warm 100ml honey with 2 tsp hot sauce and drizzle over the chicken on the waffles.

w.note: chewy brown sugar caramel set with roasted peanuts, topped with milk chocolate and flaky salt
w.how: Line a 20cm square tin. Heat 200g brown sugar, 100g butter, 150ml cream and 2 tbsp golden syrup, stirring, then boil 6 to 8 minutes to 118C. Stir in 200g roasted salted peanuts and pour into the tin. Cool 30 minutes, spread with 150g melted milk chocolate and sprinkle with flaky salt. Chill 2 hours and cut into squares.

d.note: lemon juice and sugar syrup topped up cold, 5 and 3 litre jugs to make 4
d.how: Dissolve 300g caster sugar in 300ml hot water and cool. Add 400ml lemon juice, about 10 lemons, and top up with cold water to exactly 4 litres. Work it out with a 5 litre and a 3 litre jug if you're feeling brave. Serve over ice.
